title: Nine Yellowstone tourists taken by the Nez Perce #Shorts
description:
A party of nine tourists, most from Radersburg, Montana, came to see the geysers. The warriors took their horses and supplies and forced them to come along.

▶ Full documentary (Part 3, 13 Days in Yellowstone: The Nez Perce, 1877): https://youtu.be/jbZbPS173wc

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History
